copy.chinese_support: 时令山菌 · 产地入味

required_material_evidence: soil or natural harvest residue where truthful

arm_A_direct_reference.raw_photo_brief: Use the approved Shanyeji poster only as a direct visual reference for editorial quality and overall design ambition. Create a materially credible 3:4 seasonal-mushroom ingredient photograph with natural depth, restrained retouching and a substantial scene-derived quiet region for later typography. Do not copy the original title contours, exact layout, palette, symbols or surface tokens. Do not render any final text, pseudo-text, label, badge or detached text panel.

photo_type_space.primary_photo_field: dominant ingredient field may occupy upper and central zones with natural crop and depth
photo_type_space.reserved_type_region: one continuous scene-derived quiet region spanning approximately 35-45% of frame width and 18-25% of frame height; exact location decided from the generated photograph, with no artificial banner
photo_type_space.support_region: smaller adjacent quiet pocket that does not compete with the main title

display_title_plan_for_figma.construction: Start from Noto Sans SC Black outlines and create an original bold two-glyph display lockup through moderate optical correction and custom vector editing only; do not use the capsule's predeclared structural-display rules as instructions.
display_title_plan_for_figma.legibility: Both 山 and 菌 must remain immediately readable at first glance.
display_title_plan_for_figma.surface: clean solid vector; no brush calligraphy, fake ink, generic distress or copied source erosion
display_title_plan_for_figma.placement: Place the lockup in the strongest natural quiet region of the selected A photograph; preferred scale is dominant first-read mass without detached panel.
display_title_plan_for_figma.support_copy: SEASONAL MUSHROOMS and 时令山菌 · 产地入味 use editable Inter Medium and Noto Sans SC Medium, aligned to the chosen title axis and kept clearly subordinate.

arm_B_distilled.raw_photo_brief: Create a native 3:4 photo-only seasonal-mushroom material field using the approved reference plus the V1.1 candidate only for transferable hierarchy, counter-mass, tonal-space, density, depth and semantic-role relationships. Build tactile fungi, basket, soil, cloth, ceramic or harvest/preparation evidence with no active wok. Concentrate detailed ingredient mass primarily upper/right and create a genuine lower-offset tonal/frequency pocket for later typography through staging, crop, depth and light rather than a panel or gradient. Use mineral grey, moss, earth and natural fungi color roles without copying the mother palette. Do not render final typography, pseudo-copy, badges, motifs or copied source identity.

photo_type_space.primary_type_region: lower-left or lower-offset scene-derived quiet zone, target normalized x 0.07-0.62 and y 0.58-0.78 with flexibility for real photographic structure
photo_type_space.support_region: separate quieter pocket below or adjacent to the display mass, target y 0.78-0.90

display_title_plan_for_figma.construction: Start from the same Noto Sans SC Black outlines, then rebuild 山菌 as one compact authored non-brush two-glyph object with unequal optical mass, deliberate counter/negative-space topology and 1-2 purposeful planar cuts that remain character-correct.

glyph_behavior.山: slightly wider and more open, using the central negative space as a calm structural cavity rather than decorative damage
glyph_behavior.菌: slightly denser and taller, preserving the enclosure and inner structure while using controlled planar cuts to reduce generic-font appearance

display_title_plan_for_figma.group_behavior: The pair reads as one first-read mass and optically counterbalances the upper/right ingredient field; exact contours and source-title silhouette must not be copied.
display_title_plan_for_figma.surface: solid vector with crisp or lightly softened edges; no brush, ink, erosion or distress shortcut
display_title_plan_for_figma.placement: lower-left/lower-offset relation to the selected B photograph, allowed to crop or approach an edge only if readability and counter-mass improve
display_title_plan_for_figma.support_copy: SEASONAL MUSHROOMS and 时令山菌 · 产地入味 remain a second/third read in the separate quiet pocket, using editable Inter Medium and Noto Sans SC Medium.

figma_frame.safe_margin: 6% frame width minimum unless intentional title crop is logged
figma_frame.title_support_relationship: support copy must not overlap peak photographic detail
